turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Chris calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: customer

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the right one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see account

turns.text: The amount past due today is $110.16.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've been dealing with a lot of anxiety.

turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.text: I can pay 70 the 9th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $70.00 on September 9. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying through the app or banking?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else can help you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
